releaseSemantics.existingMeter: meter.unique contains Llimit/Rlimit and Ltruth/Rtruth unique line keys; code charges all four

releaseSemantics.excluded: Reruns, Ltruth/Rtruth (reframes), unsaved runs, previews, UI progress ticks, daily affirmations
releaseSemantics.retained: Existing meter.unique remains the single writer for all paid new ground; milestone derived with filter, never a competing mutable count
releaseSemantics.userTerminology: One unique 'pattern' means one released line key per current engine definition, not necessarily one entire narrative imprint or complex
releaseSemantics.snapshot: Optional archived release-key total only on model-compatible snapshots, so history cannot be fabricated backwards

invariants: Exactly one source for CQ: compute().CQ, no avatar-specific recomputation.
Position only when full 21-law CQ is genuinely complete (not seeded or skipped).
No persistent stageId required: derive on render to avoid drift.
All CQ snapshots compare only same model version, with baseline from first complete reading.
Unique release milestones never increment on rerun or truth-side installation.
Ritual practice is logged even with no CQ change and must never trigger artificial increase.
Active encounter may be anywhere, irrespective of numerical CQ waypoint.
No diagnosis or moral character label inferred from map position.
Profile export/import must preserve identity, CQ inputs, history, release keys, and user-selected journey, including consent.
Declines and downward CQ movement are represented without deleting earned work.
